narration.text: So if you have a story idea but can't draw, describe the scene, genre, and characters, and BoredComic does the rest.
Most AI tools just spit out one image, leaving you to figure out the story, the panels, and the dialogue yourself.
Meet BoredComic, an AI studio that writes the storyboard, draws every panel, and keeps characters consistent across pages.
You describe a scenario, genre, and characters; BoredComic writes the storyboard, generates the panel art, and hands you a finished comic.
There are three tiers, from a fifty cent single scene up to a three dollar, twenty page epic, plus per-page revisions and reusable characters.
So head over to OKX dot AI, find BoredComic, and start generating your very first illustrated comic today.
